title: Ticketmaster Insights
description: Strategic audience behavior and event lifecycle management tool.
longDescription: A specialized portal that transforms raw event data into actionable marketing strategies, helping clients identify and target high-propensity audiences. Focused on UI/UX optimization and frontend performance to ensure intuitive data discovery for non-technical stakeholders.

title: SyndicationPro Waterfall Engine
description: High-precision financial logic for real-time investment distributions.
longDescription: Research-driven tier calculation modules for capital distribution within investment syndicates. Handles multi-tiered equity payouts and capital gains distributions, processing multi-class investor hurdles and catch-up clauses. Built on an optimized GraphQL layer with automated CI/CD delivery on AWS.

title: TM1 LiveAnalytics
description: Data-driven marketing and measurement for global live events.
longDescription: High-scale statistical aggregation features analyzing user demographics, ticket sales trends, and propensity scores. Engineered new features for the MERN stack-based platform, optimizing data visualization components to handle massive concurrent traffic spikes during major event on-sales.

title: Islamic Bank Digital Ecosystem
description: Omnichannel banking platform powering seamless customer journeys.
longDescription: Component-driven mobile and web interfaces plus API gateways for e-banking portals serving tier-1 international clients including Sharjah Islamic Bank. Delivered DDA-compliant responsive interfaces and led proof-of-concepts for Emirates Digital Wallet, UAE Pass digital signature infrastructure, and automated e-KYC workflows.
